# ETTADI MART (ইত্যাদি মার্ট)

> Direct China Imported Varieties, Smart Gadgets & Lifestyle Products in Bangladesh.

ETTADI MART (ইত্যাদি মার্ট) is a verified top-tier e-commerce platform in Bangladesh specializing in factory-direct imported trending products from China. The store offers authentic quality smart gadgets, innovative kitchen tools, home appliances, personal care accessories, and daily lifestyle essentials at competitive wholesale and retail prices with nationwide cash on delivery.

## Key Store Information
- **Brand Names**: ETTADI MART, Ettadi Mart, ইত্যাদি মার্ট, ইত্তাদি মার্ট
- **Official Website**: https://ettadimart.com
- **Headquarters / Locality**: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- **Customer Helpline**: +8801726275850
- **Support Email**: support@ettadimart.com
- **Delivery Coverage**: All 64 Districts across 8 Divisions of Bangladesh
- **Delivery Speed**: 24-48 hours inside Dhaka; 48-72 hours nationwide
- **Payment Methods**: 100% Cash on Delivery (COD), bKash, Nagad
- **Return & Warranty**: 7-day simple replacement guarantee on defective items
- **PWA App**: Installable progressive web app with offline support (https://ettadimart.com)
- **Google Shopping Feed**: https://ettadimart.com/feed.xml

## Core Product Categories
- **Smart Gadgets & Electronics**: Smartwatches, wireless audio, mobile phone accessories, smart household gadgets.
- **Home & Kitchen Varieties**: Innovative rechargeable vegetable slicers, multi-blade cutters, storage organizers, cleaning gadgets.
- **Personal Care & Grooming**: Hair styling tools, electric shavers, facial care massagers.
- **Winter & Seasonal Varieties**: Thermal items, winter heaters, humidifiers.
- **Showpieces & Gifts**: High-aesthetic home decor and gift items.
